title: Amtrak's historical ADA program covers responsibility at 385 of 515 required stations
summary: The station plan states that 515 Amtrak-system stations were required to be accessible under the ADA and that Amtrak had full or partial ADA responsibility at 385. Denominator: The 515-station statutory system boundary and the nested 385-station Amtrak-responsibility portfolio as defined in the FY24-29 plan.
